budget.checkpoint_IO_and_setup: recorded separately, not claimed as measured V5 fit cost

continuation.best_control: lowest mean individual-seed RMSE among all five neural controls and the two analytical controls
continuation.seed_wins_reference: neural control with lowest mean individual-seed RMSE; compare same seed, deterministic recipe order breaks exact ties
continuation.maximum_MAE_ratio_reference: neural control with lowest mean individual-seed RMSE
continuation.meaning: engineering development continuation only; not significance, practical delta of R3, or accreditation
continuation.failures: incomplete_or_failed_pilot_no_continuation; no automatic replacement by winning ablation

data.purged_rows_scope: seven selection-assessment dates; additionally seven fit-selection dates; fourteen total excluded

mechanism.reference_rms: sqrt(mean of squared six known close-log returns across fitting windows)
mechanism.common_atom_scale: mean_fit(U); equivalently gamma=mean_fit(U)/reference_rms and d_out in physical return units
mechanism.encoder_input_price: log(OHLC/last_known_close) divided by local window scale or fixed fitting reference; channel mean/SD estimated on fit only
mechanism.encoder_input_volume: log1p(volume), fit mean/SD; same volume feature in every recipe
mechanism.mixed_precision: FP32 encoder and attention; FP64 readout
mechanism.initialization: same M00 backbone and same atomic head seed; input features and reconstruction factors intentionally differ

reporting.primary: mean of per-seed RMSE, not sqrt of pooled seed MSE

future_confirmation.family_control: Holm at0.05; declared global procedure level as appropriate
future_confirmation.additional_consistency: better mean in >=2/3, no significantly worse contrast in any

AI_assistance: Declared: literature review, equations, implementation, software verification and experimental design; author must understand and defend the work.
